老兵探路者 APL 移动豁免耐伤
2 6" 5+ 8
名称攻击命中伤害武器规则
脉冲卡宾枪 4 3+ 4/5 -
枪托 3 4+ 2/3 -
兵法：战略计划，如果该特工位于杀戮区内。选择
以下一个效果进行生效，持续至转折点结束为止。
在每场战斗中每个选项您不能选择超过一次：
• 蒙特’卡：己方探路者特工的移动属性提升 1"。
• 考雍：如果己方探路者特工拥有隐匿命令，则
它们可以在激活期间执行一次无消耗的标记光行
动。
标记光 1AP
参见“标记光”阵营规则。
探路者、钛帝国、领袖、老兵 25

cards.title_zh: 无人机控制员探路者-能力卡
cards.image: 01-06-特工能力-无人机控制员探路者-能力卡.png
cards.text:
无人机控制员探路者 APL 移动豁免耐伤
2 6" 5+ 7
远程操控 1AP
位于杀戮区内的一名己方探路者无人机特工可
以立刻执行一次无消耗的行动，但是在那次行动
中不能移动超过 2"。那次行动可以是通常受到
“无人机”规则限制的一种行动（本规则的优先
度高于那些规则)。
本特工不能在敌方特工的控制范围内执行此行
动。本特工可以在激活期间多次执行此行动，但
在这么做时，同一名无人机特工在每一次激活中
执行的相同无消耗行动的次数不能超过一次。
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
DRONE CONTROLLER PATHFINDER
2 6" 5+ 7
REMOTE PILOT 1AP
One friendly PATHFINDER DRONE operative can
immediately perform one free action, but it cannot move
more than 2" during that action. That action can be one
that’s normally restricted by its Drone rule (this takes
precedence over that rule).
This operative cannot perform this action while within control
range of an enemy operative. This operative can perform this
action more than once during its activation, but if it does,
the same DRONE operative cannot perform the same free
action more than once per activation.

cards.text:

脉冲卡宾枪 4 4+ 4/5 -

医疗兵!：在每个转折点中，首次有另一名位于该特工 3" 内且可见的己方探路者特工（无人机除外）将被
残废时，如果该特工或者那名特工不位于敌方特工的控制范围内，那么您可以使用此规则。若使用，那么
那名己方特工不会被残废，并且剩余 1 点耐伤并且直到行动结束前不能被残废。在那次行动结束后，那名
己方特工可以立即执行一次无消耗的冲刺行动，但是必须在该特工的控制范围内结束这次移动。直到该特
工和那名特工的下一次激活结束前，他们的 APL 属性各减少 1 点。如果您在那名特工的激活期间使用了本
规则，那么那次激活结束。您不能在该特工残废时，或者在该特工被选择成为一次射击行动的主要或次要
目标时使用此规则。
请继续阅读背面规则
探路者、钛帝国、医疗、医疗技师 25
cards.text_en:
APL MOVE SAVE WOUNDS
MEDICAL TECHNICIAN PATHFINDER
2 6" 5+ 7
NAME ATK HIT DMG WR
Pulse carbine 4 4+ 4/5 -
Gun butt 3 5+ 2/3 -
Medic!: The first time during each turning point that another friendly PATHFINDER operative (excluding DRONE) would be
incapacitated while visible to and within 3" of this operative, you can use this rule, providing neither this nor that operative is within
control range of an enemy operative. If you do, that friendly operative isn’t incapacitated, has 1 wound remaining and cannot be
incapacitated for the remainder of the action. After that action, that friendly operative can immediately perform a free Dash action,
but must end that move within this operative’s control range. Subtract 1 from this and that operative’s APL stats until the end of their
next activations respectively, and if this rule was used during that friendly operative’s activation, that activation ends. You cannot use
this rule if this operative is incapacitated, or if it’s a Shoot action and this operative would be a primary or secondary target.
RULES CONTINUE ON OTHER SIDE
PATHFINDER , T'AU EMPIRE, MEDIC, MEDICAL TECHNICIAN 25

Group Activation: Whenever this operative is expended, you

SHAS’LA operative (if able) before your opponent activates.

activates as normal (in other words, you cannot activate more
than two operatives in succession with this rule).

Markerlight action while within control range of an enemy
operative (this takes precedence over the Markerlight action’s
normal conditions). In addition, this operative can perform the
Fall Back action for 1 less AP.

cards.text:
探路者
阵营规则
标记光
标记光是一种激光瞄准系统，能够将目标的
信息数据上传至周边钛星人单位的武器瞄具
以及头盔系统上。
一些探路者特工（在数据卡上表示）可以执行
标记光独特行动：
标记光 1AP
选择一名对该特工可见的敌方特工。那名
敌方特工获得一枚己方标记光指示物（最
多 4 枚)。
一名特工不能在敌方特工的控制范围内执行
此行动。如果一名特工会在同一次激活中执
行此行动以及射击行动（戒备除外)，那么
只有那次射击行动的目标能被选择成为本行
动的目标（反之亦然)。
请继续阅读背面规则
cards.text_en:
PATHFINDER
FACTION RULE
MARKERLIGHTS
Markerlights are laser targeting systems that feed
information to the weapon-mounted scopes and helmet
targeting systems of nearby T’au units.
Some PATHFINDER operatives (indicated on
their datacard) can perform the Markerlight
unique action:
MARKERLIGHT 1AP
Select one enemy operative visible to this
operative. That enemy operative gains one
of your Markerlight tokens (to a maximum
of four).
An operative cannot perform this action
while within control range of an enemy
operative. If an operative (excluding MB3
RECON) would perform the Shoot action
(excluding Guard) and this action during
the same activation, only the target of that
Shoot action can be selected for this action
(and vice versa).
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
每次激活限一次，每当一名拥有任何己方标记光
指示物的敌方特工执行冲刺、冲锋、后撤或转移
行动时，移除一枚标记光指示物。
虽然只有部分探路者特工可以执行标记光行
动，但所有探路者特工都能够获得它的增益效
果。每当一名己方探路者特工使用其数据卡上
的武器进行射击时（突击掷弹兵的融合手雷除
外)，那件武器会根据目标拥有的标记光指示物
数量获得额外的效果。这些效果是叠加的，因此
如果一名敌方特工拥有两枚己方标记光指示物，
那么进行射击的己方特工在流程中获得 1 枚和 2
枚指示物的规则。
请继续阅读背面规则
cards.text_en:
Once during each of their activations, whenever
an enemy operative that has any of your
Markerlight tokens performs the Dash, Charge,
Fall Back or Reposition action, remove one of
those tokens.
While only some PATHFINDER operatives can
perform the Markerlight action, all PATHFINDER
operatives can benefit from its effects. Whenever
a friendly PATHFINDER operative is shooting
with a weapon from its datacard (excluding
ASSAULT GRENADIER’s fusion grenade), it has
additional rules determined by the number of
your Markerlight tokens the target has. These are
cumulative, so if an enemy operative has two of
your Markerlight tokens, the friendly operative
shooting it has the rules for 1 and 2 tokens during
that sequence.
CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
探路者
战略计谋
侦察扫描
探路者专门负责执行侦察任务，他们十分擅
长穿越复杂的地形并包抄毫无防备的敌人。
选择一个杀戮区边缘（己方杀戮区边缘除外）。
每一名完全位于那个边缘 6" 内的己方探路者特
工可以立即执行一次无消耗的冲刺行动，但是每
一个执行了该行动的特工必须在结束移动时完全
位于一个杀戮区边缘的 6" 内（己方杀戮区边缘
除外)。您不能在第一转折点中使用本计谋。
cards.text_en:
PATHFINDER
STRATEGY PLOY
RECON SWEEP
Pathfinders are tasked with reconnaissance roles
and are skilled at crossing difficult terrain to outflank
unsuspecting targets.
Select one killzone edge (excluding your own).
Each friendly PATHFINDER operative that’s
wholly within 6" of that edge can immediately
perform a free Dash action in an order of your
choice, but each that does so must end that move
wholly within 6" of a killzone edge (excluding your
own). You cannot use this ploy during the first
turning point.

cards.text:
探路者
战略计谋
火力压制
探路者们以暴风雪一般的火力迫使敌人寻找
掩护，让他们难以还击。
每当一名敌方特工执行射击行动时，如果目标
（如果武器拥有“爆炸”或“洪流”武器规
则，则是主要目标）不是最近的有效目标，那
么您的对手不能重掷攻击骰。在判断本规则的
效果时，忽略拥有隐匿命令或者被遮挡的己方
探路者特工。
cards.text_en:
PATHFINDER
STRATEGY PLOY
SUPPRESSING FIRE
T’au Pathfinders lay down a punishing blizzard of fire,
forcing their enemies to take cover and fire back in
scattered, desperate bursts.
Whenever an enemy operative is performing the
Shoot action, if the target (the primary target
if the weapon has the Blast or Torrent weapon
rules) isn’t the closest valid target, your opponent
cannot re-roll their attack dice. Ignore friendly
PATHFINDER operatives that have a Conceal
order or are obscured when determining this.

cards.text:
探路者
战略计谋
团结一致
烈火战士小队的成员们通常在儿时就一同经
受训练，并通过仪式结义成为同伴，他们拥
有着一种超凡的默契。
每当一名己方探路者特工（无人机除外）进行
射击或者使用远程武器进行反击时（参见“零距
离连射”交战计谋)，如果这名特工位于另一名
己方探路者特工（无人机除外）的 3" 内，那么
第一名己方特工的远程武器还拥有“精准 1”武
器规则。
cards.text_en:
PATHFINDER
STRATEGY PLOY
BONDED
Often trained together from youth and bonded by blood
ritual, Fire Warrior teams possess an uncanny degree
of coordination.
Whenever a friendly PATHFINDER operative
(excluding DRONE) is shooting or retaliating with
a ranged weapon (see Point-Blank Fusillade
firefight ploy), if it’s within 3" of another friendly
PATHFINDER operative (excluding DRONE), that
first friendly operative’s ranged weapons have the
Accurate 1 weapon rule.

cards.text:
探路者
战略计谋
找掩护
探路者们身穿轻甲，装备轻便。要想生存，他
们就必须充分利用身边地形所提供的优势。
每当一名特工对己方探路者特工进行射击时，
如果您可以保留任何掩护豁免，那么那名己方特
工的豁免属性提升 1。
cards.text_en:
PATHFINDER
STRATEGY PLOY
TAKE COVER
Pathfinders are lightly armoured and equipped for
mobility. They must use surrounding terrain to their
advantage in order to survive.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
PATHFINDER operative, if you can retain any
cover saves, improve that friendly operative’s
Save stat by 1.

cards.text:
探路者
交战计谋
高上大义
无论多么危险，任何能够推进上上善道的行
动都必须被迅速且毫不犹豫地执行。
在交战阶段开始时使用此交战计谋。一名己方探
路者特工（无人机除外）可以立刻执行一次无
消耗的任务行动。
cards.text_en:
PATHFINDER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
A WORTHY CAUSE
Any action that furthers the Greater Good must be
undertaken swiftly and without question, no matter
how dangerous.
Use this firefight ploy at the start of the Firefight
phase. One friendly PATHFINDER operative
(excluding DRONE) can immediately perform a
free mission action.

cards.text:
探路者
交战计谋
支援射击
探路者们是优秀的神枪手，就算在同伴陷入
近距离战斗时也能够为其提供火力支援。
在一名己方探路者特工执行射击行动并选择 6"
内的有效目标时使用本交战计谋。如果一名敌方
特工的控制范围内存在其他己方探路者特工，
那么这个情况不会防止这名敌方特工被选择成为
目标。
cards.text_en:
PATHFINDER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
SUPPORTING FIRE
T’au Pathfinders are expert sharpshooters and can grant
covering fire even to allies engaged in close combat.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly
PATHFINDER operative is performing the Shoot
action and you’re selecting a valid target within
6" of it. Having other friendly PATHFINDER
operatives within an enemy operative’s control
range doesn’t prevent that enemy operative from
being selected.

cards.text:
探路者
交战计谋
拯救协议
钛星人的无人机被写入了保护其他人员安全
的硬代码，在一位战士遭到攻击时，无人机
会自动飞向同伴的身边进行保护。
在一名己方探路者特工（无人机除外）被选择
成为射击行动的有效目标时使用本交战计谋。
选择一名位于成为目标的己方特工的 3" 内且对
其可见的己方探路者无人机特工，选择的特工
将替代成为那次射击的有效目标（就算特工在
通常情况下不能被选择成为目标)。那个己方无
人机特工只有在原本的目标拥有掩护或被遮挡
时才能拥有对应的效果。本计谋对使用带有“爆
炸”或者“洪流”武器规则的武器所进行的射击
行动无效。
cards.text_en:
PATHFINDER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
SAVIOUR PROTOCOLS
T’au drones are hard-coded to prioritise the
safety of their operators, and will automatically
interpose themselves between a T’au warrior and an
incoming attack.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly
PATHFINDER operative (excluding DRONE) is
selected as the valid target of a Shoot action.
Select one friendly PATHFINDER DRONE
operative visible to and within 3" of that first
friendly operative to become the valid target
instead (even if it wouldn’t normally be valid for
this). That friendly DRONE operative is only in
cover or obscured if the original target was. This
ploy has no effect if the ranged weapon has the
Blast or Torrent weapon rule.

cards.text:
探路者
交战计谋
零距离连射
探路者们能够熟练运用手中的远程武器，就
算是在近距离战斗中也没有任何问题。
在一名己方探路者特工（无人机除外）进行反
击时，如果那名特工在激活或反应开始时没有
位于敌方特工的控制范围内，那么您可以使用
本交战计谋。在那个流程中，您可以将特工装
备的一件远程武器作为近战武器进行使用（名称
中拥有“手雷”一词的武器除外)。若这么做，
您不能在那个流程中进行格挡，并且直到流程结
束前，以下武器规则无法生效：“毁灭”、“穿
刺”、“洪流”。如果那名己方特工处于就绪，
拥有交战命令，并且使用一件脉冲武器进行反
击，那么您将结算第一枚攻击骰（也就是防御方
比攻击方优先结算）。
cards.text_en:
PATHFINDER
FIREFIGHT PLOY
POINT-BLANK FUSILLADE
Wielding their ranged weapons with practised skill,
Pathfinders are capable of utilising them even at
close quarters.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly
PATHFINDER operative (excluding DRONE) is
retaliating, if it wasn’t within control range of
enemy operatives at the start of that activation/
counteraction. You can use one of its ranged
weapons as a melee weapon (excluding a weapon
that has the word ‘grenade’ in its name) during
that sequence. If you do, you cannot block during
that sequence, and the following weapon rules
have no effect on its weapons until the end of
that sequence: Devastating, Piercing, Torrent. If
that friendly operative is ready, has an Engage
order and is retaliating with a pulse weapon, you
resolve the first attack dice (i.e. defender instead
of attacker).

cards.text:
探路者
阵营装备
目标分析镜
这种先进的瞄具能够提升标记光的效果，让
持有者的射击变得异常精准。
每个转折点限一次，当一名己方探路者特工
（无人机除外）进行射击行动，并选择有效目
标时，您可以使用此规则。若这么做，那么直
到那次行动结束前，如果目标拥有至少一枚己
方标记光指示物，那么将其视为拥有额外一枚
标记光指示物。如果选择的武器拥有“爆炸”
或“洪流”武器规则，那么只有首要目标会受
到本规则的影响。
cards.text_en:
PATHFINDER
FACTION EQUIPMENT
TARGET ANALYSIS OPTIC
Advanced optics enhance the effectiveness of
markerlights, ensuring the bearer’s shots find their mark
with unerring accuracy.
Once per turning point, when a friendly
PATHFINDER operative (excluding DRONE) is
performing the Shoot action and you’re selecting
a valid target, you can use this rule. If you do,
until the end of that action, if the target has at
least one of your Markerlight tokens, it's treated
as having one more. If the ranged weapon has
the Blast or Torrent weapon rule, only the primary
target is affected.

cards.text:
探路者
阵营装备
高强度标记光
这种标记光的效率极佳，其发射出的光线能
够穿透烟雾、废墟和软掩体。
每个转折点最多两次，当一名己方探路者特工
（MV7 标记无人机除外）执行标记光行动时，
您可以使用本规则。若这么做，那么您选择的
敌方特工将获得 2 枚己方标记光指示物（而不
是 1 枚）。
cards.text_en:
PATHFINDER
FACTION EQUIPMENT
HIGH-INTENSITY MARKERLIGHT
This markerlight is exceptionally effective, its beam
traceable even through obscuring smoke, debris and
soft cover.
Up to twice per turning point, when a friendly
PATHFINDER operative (excluding MV7
MARKER DRONE) performs the Markerlight
action, you can use this rule. If you do, the enemy
operative you select gains two of your Markerlight
tokens (instead of one).

cards.text:
探路者
阵营装备
光子手雷
在引爆后，光子手雷所释放出的多光谱强光
能够致盲并眩晕范围内的目标。
每个转折点限一次，一名数据卡上拥有标记光行
动的己方探路者特工（无人机除外）可以执行
以下独特行动：
光子手雷 1AP
为该特工选择一名对这名特工可见的敌方特
工并掷一枚 D6：若结果为 3+，那么直到
那名特工的下一次激活结束前，其移动属性
减少 2"。
一名特工不能在敌方特工的控制范围内执行
此行动。
cards.text_en:
PATHFINDER
FACTION EQUIPMENT
PHOTON GRENADE
Upon reaching their destination, photon grenades
release bright pulses of multispectrum light that blind
and shock those caught in the blast.
Once per turning point, a friendly PATHFINDER
operative that has the Markerlight action on their
datacard (excluding DRONE) can perform the
following unique action:
PHOTON GRENADE 1AP
Select one enemy operative visible to this
operative and roll one D6: on a 3+, until
the end of that operative’s next activation,
subtract 2" from its Move stat.
An operative cannot perform this
action while within control range of an
enemy operative.

cards.text:
探路者
阵营装备
轨道观察协助
钛星人的宇宙飞船装备有极其有效的扫描系
统，就算在星球的轨道上也可以准确侦测并
标记单兵目标。
每个转折点限一次，当一名己方探路者特工执
行标记光行动时，您可以使用本规则。若使用，
那么您可以选择一名位于杀戮区内的敌方特工并
使其获得一枚标记光指示物（而不是选择对特工
可见的目标)。本规则无法与“高强度标记光”
或者“分析”规则的效果叠加。
cards.text_en:
PATHFINDER
FACTION EQUIPMENT
ORBITAL SURVEY UPLINK
So effective are the scanning matrices of T’au voidships
that they can detect and illuminate a single infantry
target, even from orbit.
Once per turning point, when a friendly
PATHFINDER operative performs the
Markerlight action, you can use this rule. If you
do, you can select one enemy operative in the
killzone to gain one of your Markerlight tokens
instead (it doesn’t need to be visible). This isn’t
cumulative with the High-intensity Markerlight or
Analyse rules.
